create_ilp_solver: create an ILPSolver instance to solve integer linear programming problems
create_integer_var: create an integer variable with optional lower and upper bounds for the solver
create_real_var: create a real-valued variable for use in the ILP solver constraints
add_constraint: add a linear constraint expression to the ILP solver problem
set_objective_function: set the objective function to minimize or maximize in the ILP solver
